title: Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes
summary:
This website, "Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes," offers a vast collection of paper airplane designs for enthusiasts to fold or purchase products related to them. Users can browse 109 exclusive planes, filtering by folding difficulty (Very Easy to Expert), plane type (Dart, Glider, Hybrid, Jet, Stunt), designer, and paper type.

Each airplane entry provides details on Speed, Glide, and Accuracy, along with a unique descriptor. Highlights include world record holders like Firefly 5 (flies over 300 feet) and Unite (31.2 seconds aloft). The collection features popular designs such as Arrowhead, with tutorials viewed over 100 million times, alongside unique planes like AeroDactyl, which flaps as it flies, and specialist models like Ballista, the fastest on the site, or Elanus, an exceptional glider. Designers like Michael LaFosse and Kyle Boyer contribute iconic and high-performance jets. The diverse selection caters to all skill levels, from very easy gliders like Mystic and Vapor to expert-level origami masterpieces such as Eclipse and Lancer, ensuring there's a perfect paper airplane for every preference.
chinese_title: 折叠飞行：最好的纸飞机
chinese_summary:
本网站《可折叠飞行：最佳纸飞机》为爱好者提供了大量的纸飞机设计，供他们折叠或购买相关产品。用户可以浏览109款独家纸飞机，并按折叠难度（从“非常简单”到“专家级”）、飞机类型（镖型、滑翔型、混合型、喷气型、特技型）、设计师和纸张类型进行筛选。

每款纸飞机的条目都提供了速度、滑翔和精准度的详细信息，以及独特的描述。亮点包括世界纪录保持者，如“萤火虫5号”（飞行超过300英尺）和“联结号”（空中停留31.2秒）。该系列收录了热门设计，如教程观看量超过1亿次的“箭头号”，此外还有独特的飞机，如飞行时会拍动翅膀的“翼手龙号”，以及专业模型，如网站上最快的“弩炮号”，或性能卓越的滑翔机“鹞鹰号”。迈克尔·拉福斯和凯尔·博耶等设计师贡献了标志性的高性能喷气式飞机。多样化的选择满足了所有技能水平的需求，从“神秘号”和“蒸汽号”等非常简单的滑翔机，到“日食号”和“枪骑兵号”等专家级折纸杰作，确保每种偏好都能找到完美的纸飞机。

title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
summary:
Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, advanced models designed for complex technical challenges. They offer significant improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, demonstrating capabilities like completing infeasible software migrations, designing electronic devices, solving physics problems, advancing robotics, and formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem.

Fable 5.2, available to all users, includes robust cybersecurity and biology safeguards. Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model with fewer safeguards, targets beneficial applications in cybersecurity and biomedical research through verification programs.

These new models communicate clearer, generate outputs 30% faster than their predecessors, and are offered at a lower price ($8 input/$40 output per million tokens), with an optional fast mode. Extensive safety testing, including novel evaluations, ensures alignment and stronger protection against distillation attacks.

Fable/Mythos 5.2 are recommended for ambitious, open-ended technical tasks, outperforming Claude Opus 5.5 and other frontier models in benchmarks across agentic coding, scientific research, cybersecurity, protein design, computer use, robotics, and multidisciplinary reasoning. They deliver higher accuracy at a lower cost per task.

In real-world applications, Fable 5.2 drives Anthropic's core codebase, optimizes services, and even prototyped a full operating system. Testers praise its engineering judgment and ability to tackle ambiguous, complex projects. Mythos 5.2 is Anthropic's most capable model for cybersecurity, catching more vulnerabilities with better judgment than previous models and competitors, accessible via the Cyber Verification Program.
chinese_title: 克劳德寓言 5.2 和 神话 5.2
chinese_summary:
Anthropic已推出Claude Fable 5.2和Mythos 5.2，这些是专为应对复杂技术挑战而设计的高级模型。它们在编码、推理和视觉能力方面提供了显著改进，展现了完成看似不可能的软件迁移、设计电子设备、解决物理问题、推动机器人技术发展以及形式化费马大定理等能力。

Fable 5.2面向所有用户开放，包含强大的网络安全和生物学防护措施。Mythos 5.2是相同的基础模型，但防护措施较少，旨在通过验证计划用于网络安全和生物医学研究领域的有益应用。

这些新模型沟通更清晰，生成输出的速度比前代快30%，并且价格更低（每百万token输入8美元/输出40美元），并提供可选的快速模式。广泛的安全测试（包括新颖的评估方法）确保了对齐，并提供了更强的防蒸馏攻击保护。

Fable/Mythos 5.2推荐用于雄心勃勃的开放式技术任务，在自主编码、科学研究、网络安全、蛋白质设计、计算机使用、机器人技术和多学科推理等领域的基准测试中，它们超越了Claude Opus 5.5和其他前沿模型。它们以更低的每任务成本提供更高的准确性。

在实际应用中，Fable 5.2驱动着Anthropic的核心代码库、优化服务，甚至原型化了一个完整的操作系统。测试人员称赞其工程判断力以及处理模糊、复杂项目的能力。Mythos 5.2是Anthropic在网络安全领域最强大的模型，以更好的判断力捕获比先前模型和竞争对手更多的漏洞，可通过网络验证计划获取。

title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
summary:
Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, advanced models engineered to tackle the most demanding technical challenges. These models show significant improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, having demonstrated impressive capabilities such as completing infeasible software migrations, designing electronic devices, solving open physics problems, and formalizing Fermat’s Last Theorem.

Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are based on the same core model. Fable 5.2 includes robust cybersecurity and biology safeguards, making it available to all users. Mythos 5.2, without these specific safeguards, is offered to organizations pursuing beneficial applications in cybersecurity or biomedical research through verification programs.

These new models offer clearer communication, generate outputs up to 30% faster than their 5.1 predecessors, and are available at lower prices: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. An optional fast mode boosts token generation by up to 2.5 times. Extensive safety testing was conducted, ensuring strong alignment measures and protection against distillation attacks.

While Claude Opus 5.5 is recommended for most daily coding and knowledge tasks, Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are designed for the most ambitious, open-ended technical work, also serving as Advisor or Orchestrator models. Benchmarks reveal they consistently outperform Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Carbon across various capabilities, including agentic coding, scientific research, and robotics.

Fable 5.2 is integral to Anthropic's internal coding, having helped migrate production services and design a prototype operating system. Mythos 5.2 excels in cybersecurity, identifying significantly more vulnerabilities than previous models and competitors, accessible via verification programs or Claude Security for enterprise customers.

title: USPS now offers official ZIP Code boundary polygons
summary:
The USPS now offers "USPS® ZIP Code Boundaries," a new product providing official polygon data for ZIP Code areas. This national map is built on USPS delivery address and location information, ensuring accurate boundaries that reflect temporal fluctuations due to changing delivery distributions.

These boundary data are highly beneficial for industries such as mapping, mailing, marketing, insurance, real estate, logistics, navigation, and transportation. Users can incorporate these polygons as the definitive "ground truth" for ZIP Code boundaries, utilize them to organize and display demographic data (particularly for real estate and insurance), or employ them as a proxy for delivery location groupings to optimize routing.

The product is available in three tiers: "Internal," "Enterprise," and "Publication," all receiving four quarterly updates. The Enterprise and Publication tiers have limitations on distribution or publication. Supporting resources, including fact sheets, technical guides, sample data files (including GeoJSON), a license agreement, and an order form, are also available.
